_description: Example resolved output for Rohit Menon (EMP-1002), a night-shift employee at Pune HQ, for October 2026. Demonstrates how the SAME published HolidayCalendar (HCAL-IN-MH-2026) renders differently because of his shift assignment. This exact JSON shape is what every dependent screen (dashboard widget, leave modal, attendance grid, payroll run) consumes.

holiday.name: Diwali - Balipratipada
holiday.redundant_reason: Falls on employee's own weekly-off (WEDNESDAY); shown on calendar for visibility only, does not consume RH quota unless employee explicitly claims it as an RH leave application.

_contrast_note: Compare EMP-1001 (day shift, same Pune HQ, same HCAL-IN-MH-2026 calendar) for 2026-10-02: attributed_shift_start would be '2026-10-02T09:30:00+05:30' and spans_midnight=false means no shift-boundary adjustment is needed. Same calendar row in the DB, different rendered effect per employee -- this is the 'dynamic depending on shift timings' behavior.
